In Re : An application for anticipatory bail under sect  2023 in connection with Haringhata P.S Case no. 599 of   13.11.2024 under sections 498A/313/494 IPC read with se  115(2)/3(5) of BNS 2023  Allowed and  In Re : Kamal Hasan Mondal @ Kamal Hassan Mondal @ Mand  .
 Mr. S K Das  Mr. D Sarkar  Ms. Debalina De  ...... for the  Mr. Joydeep Roy  Ms. Piya Goswami  ...... for the  1.
Petitioner no. 1 is the husband and petitioner nos. 2 to 5 are in-laws of the victim lady and petitioner no. 6 is alleged to have married petitioner no. 1.

entities.text: Kamal Hasan Mondal @ Kamal Hassan Mondal @ Mand
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: She suffered from gynecological problems and a child had to be aborted.
Abortion due to assault is out and out false.
2. Learned lawyer for the State opposes the prayer.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
In 2019 victim lady suffered an abortion.
No contemporaneous complaint alleging assault resulting in abortion is placed on record.
On the other hand, petitioners contend abortion was due to gynecological problems.
Subsequent allegations of torture and assault are general and omnibus.
They are not supported by medical evidence.
4. Under such circumstances, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Signed By :
TAMAL KRISHNA MANDAL High Court of Calcutta 12 th of December 2024 04:28:58 PM 5.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- each with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of BNSS 2023.

6. Petitioners shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks CRM (A)/4238/2024 on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6142915/
1 from date.
7.
The application being CRM (A) 4238 of 2024 is disposed of.

(Gaurang Kanth , J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By :
